title: Museum of Natural History and Planetarium

services.name: City Hall Private Event
services.desc: City Hall is a historic building with fine architectural detail. The interior is beautiful and has several locations that are terrific for a wedding or other special occasion photographs. The Aldermen Chambers and the main marble staircase are popular locations. City Hall is open Monday through Friday 8:30 am - 4:30

services.name: Planetarium Show
services.desc: Located in the Museum of Natural History in Roger Williams Park, the Planetarium is a dome theater with a Zeiss projector that casts images of stars, planets and constellations to simulate the night sky. Sit back and journey through space in a planetarium show! The Planetarium also has an ASH Warped Media fulldome projector that showcases fulldome show offerings. Planetarium show offerings are on Saturdays and Sundays at 2pm and during certain Monday holidays and school vacation weeks. Planetarium show tickets are recommended to be reserved online as availability is limited. Please CLICK HERE to purchase planetarium show tickets and for more information about the planetarium show offerings.
